notes.title: [READ ME]UPDATE VERSION 0.7420a
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Steam Cloud Save functionality has been added.
[*] You can now create up to three save files.
[*] A save file selection feature has been added.
[*] Tournaments now appear in the order they were decided.
[*] Tournaments you have won can now be selected at any time.
[*] “Played Time” has been added.
[/list]

[h1]About Steam Cloud Save[/h1]
Steam Cloud Save is a feature that allows you to save your game progress on Steam servers and share it across multiple devices.
You will be able to share save data between multiple PCs and Steam Decks.

The folders uploaded to the server are as follows.

[Windows PC]
\Documents\My Games\PUNIHILOADER2\[b]SaveData[/b]

[Steam Deck]
/home/deck/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/compatdata/1956960/pfx/drive_c/users/steamuser/Documents/My Games/PUNIHILOADER2/[b]SaveData[/b]

In addition, to use the Steam cloud save feature,
[list]
[*] [b]The folder size must be 1MB or less.[/b]
[*] [b]The total number of files in the folder must be 10 or less.[/b]
[/list]
Please be careful if you plan to keep 11 or more save data files.

When using the Steam cloud save feature, a file named “steam_autocloud.vdf” will be generated in the save data folder. This file is automatically generated by Steam and is safe to keep. There is no need to delete it.

[h1]About the save data selection feature[/h1]
You can now select three play data files from the save data folder.
The save data folder is located as follows.

[Windows PC]
\Documents\My Games\PUNIHILOADER2\[b]SaveData[/b]

[Steam Deck]
/home/deck/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/compatdata/1956960/pfx/drive_c/users/steamuser/Documents/My Games/PUNIHILOADER2/[b]SaveData[/b]

You can select 
punihiloader2_savedata.json as data 1
punihiloader2_savedata1.json as data 2
punihiloader2_savedata2.json as data 3
in the game.
If you have four or more save data files, please rename the files as appropriate.

[h1]Entering play time into existing save data[/h1]
Played time is now recorded in save data.
However, in order to reflect the previous play time in the save data selection menu, you will need to enter the play time into the save data yourself.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but please follow the steps below to reflect the play time.

[olist]
[*] Update the game to version 0.7420a, launch the game, and save your data.
[*] Exit the game and open the save data folder. The save data location is as follows.

[Windows PC]
\Documents\My Games\PUNIHILOADER2\SaveData

[Steam Deck]
/home/deck/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/compatdata/1956960/pfx/drive_c/users/steamuser/Documents/My Games/PUNIHILOADER2/SaveData

[*] Open punihiloader2_savedata.json. You can open .json files with Notepad or similar programs.
[*] Enter the play time in seconds at the end of the string where it says [b]_IGT”:X.XXXXXXXXXX[/b].

[Input example] If you have played for 10 hours
[olist]
[*] Convert 10 hours to seconds: 10 × 3600 = 36000
[*] Enter [b]_IGT”:36000[/b]
[/olist]
[/olist]
If you have any questions, please feel free to ask in the comments section.

Thank you for your support.

[h3]Please, everyone[/h3]

I tried to fix problems with games not working properly in some languages.
Please do the test and let me know the results.


[h3]Below are the details[/h3]
Upon investigation, I found that the .csv file fails to load for French and Russian due to differences in character formats.

[code]FormatException: Input string was not in a correct format.
at System.Number.ParseSingle (System.String value, System.Globalization.NumberStyles options, System.Globalization.NumberFormatInfo numfmt) [0x00083] in <a1e9f114a6e64f4eacb529fc802ec93d>:0

at System.Single.Parse (System.String s) [0x0000b] in <a1e9f114a6e64f4eacb529fc802ec93d>:0[/code]
These error logs were.
To correct these, I added [i]CultureInfo.InvariantCulture[/i] at [i]Parse[/i] in my script.(I'm not professional at C#...)
And I tested some languages at this version, this worked on my development machine.
But I don't have true French or Russian machine, so I need the help of everyone who lives in the area.
I feel bad treating everyone like a free debugger, but I seriously need some information.

I hope it works, but there is a decent chance it won't.

Indie game developer 221GAMES will release a demo version of its game "PUNIHI LOADER 2" for Steam on September 1, 2022, and a second promotional video on the same day.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1956960/PUNIHI_LOADER_2/
[previewyoutube=yaaTgvD1c-4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]About "PUNIHI LOADER 2"[/h1]

[h2]Enter the Punihi loader battle that's all the rage at Neo-Asahikawa right now![/h2]
PUNIHI LOADER 2 is a mecha customize shooter in which Punihi a one-headed mysterious creature rides and fights on unique mecha.
In Neo Asahikawa, competitions in which the Punihis ride and fight on mecha are very popular.
Gather friends, earn funds, and buy mecha parts to reach the top of the "Neo Asahikawa League".
This demo version allows players to experience the "Arena" and "Customization," which are the core elements of the game.


[h2]Variety of mecha customization[/h2]
The mechas in the game can be customized as desired by the player.
The 10 mechas in the demo version, with a total of 60 parts, all have a unique appearance.
The coloring of the mecha can be customized, and the boarding Punihi can be dressed up as well.
Combine the 5 mecha parts and dress up your mecha to create unique mechas that look badass, cool, etc.

Weapons include basic weapons such as machine guns, missiles, and lasers, as well as melee weapons, shields, and even a pile cannon and jet punch.
The back equipment is also a powerful part that can fundamentally change the action of the game.
There is a "Jet Pack" that gives the mecha the ability to fly, a "Boost Pack" that allows rapid horizontal acceleration, an "FCS Pack" that enables auto-aim, a "Repair Pack" that restores durability values, and a "Tune Pack" that greatly improves basic performance. These packs can be refitted to give your mecha a powerful personality.

[h2]Team up with 3 mechas and become the strongest![/h2]
In the "Arena" mode, which you can play in the demo version, you can enter your own mecha as well as two customizable mechas as teammates in a 3-on-3 match.
In the demo version, you can choose from 9 teammates, but we plan to make it possible to fully customize the teammates in the future.
The teammates will fight on their own to a certain extent, and will also be able to use various tactics under the player's command.
The style of combat, which can include fighting in formation, covering from afar, or flanking, can be greatly expanded depending on the formation of mechas.
Organize your own team and go to the decisive battlefield.

[h2]Defeat a special league of 15 teams![/h2]
A total of 15 rival teams await you in a special league prepared exclusively for the demo version.
Organize your own mechs, your own team, and defeat them all!
The top rankers are tough. Try various combinations of parts.


PUNIHILOADER 2 demo version will be continuously updated after its release to expand the contents that can be played.
In addition to greatly enhancing the contents of the mecha customize shooter mentioned above, the full version will include additional elements that will allow players to fully enjoy life in Neo Asahikawa.
The release date for the full version has not yet been determined, but we are currently aiming for the end of 2023. We will continue to develop the game so that it will be available to everyone as soon as possible.
Thank you very much for your cooperation.

221GAMES
